Eligibility Criteria
To be eligible for the airdrop, users must have completed at least one of the following activities before May 1, 2021, 23:59:59 UTC:
Traders:
Conducted at least one successful swap on Dfyn.
Liquidity Providers:
Provided liquidity on Dfyn, with rewards distributed based on liquidity volume and duration.
